BEFORE YOUR FIRST CONVERSATION

Good to know.

Clear expectations from the beginning.

Where is Break Point Investigations based?+

Break Point Investigations is based in Fairfield, California. Contact DJ to discuss assignments in Solano County, the Bay Area, or elsewhere in Northern California. Coverage and travel are confirmed for each engagement.

How do I start an investigation?+

Call, text, or email DJ with a brief description of your needs, location, and deadline. He can discuss the assignment, establish the scope, and explain the next steps before work begins.

Can I send applicant files through this website?+

Please use the website only for an initial inquiry. Do not send Social Security numbers, identity documents, or sensitive case materials. Ask DJ to arrange an appropriate method for exchanging records.

How much does a background investigation cost?+

Pricing depends on the assignment, required research, interviews, travel, and reporting. Contact DJ for a scope-specific estimate and current availability.
